welcome.title: Our Story, Written in the Stars
welcome.subtitle: Some moments become memories. Some people become home.

letter.heading: To My Favourite Person
paragraphs: There are so many things I wish I could tell you, and sometimes words still feel too small.
You have become a beautiful part of my everyday life. Even the simplest moments feel special when they have you in them.
If I could keep one thing forever, it would be the feeling of being able to share this life with you.
letter.buttonText: There's something written in the moon

moon.heading: Two Birthdays. Two Moons. One Story.
moon.description: The moon was in a different phase on each of your birthdays. Here's what the sky looked like on those dates.
moon.message: Two different nights, two different skies — and somehow, your stories found a way to meet.
moon.combinedHeading: A Little Universe of Our Own
moon.combinedMessage: Not a scientific moon phase — just a symbol of two lives sharing one beautiful sky.

finalWish.heading: May We Keep Choosing Each Other
finalWish.message: I don't know what every tomorrow will look like, but I hope it holds more laughter, more little adventures, more memories, and more reasons to be grateful that our paths crossed.
finalWish.dateText: A little gift, made just for you.
